rationale: D1 terracotta roof kit (K2, D-196/D-207): bay, verge, ridge and gable pieces of several one-material parts, three LODs each, over one shared tile variant atlas whose per-tile tint rides in the UVs' integer parts (engine pbr-tint), with the gable's pre-mirrored variant and the test house's roof as an assembly in the wall kit's house frame. D-197 suspends size ceilings: sizes and triangle counts are recorded measurements, and only the structural checks gate admission.
